title: Kestrel and the Witness
author: Lena Hartwell
blurb: Silas Voss, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
